create_build:
  params: [project_id, location_id, vm_name, image_zone, base_image_family, kitchen_sa_email, new_image_name, repo_dir, playbook_archive_uri, os_family, region, logs_mode,repo_project_id,repo_name,branch_name]
  steps:
    - the_build:
        call: googleapis.cloudbuild.v1.projects.locations.builds.create
        args:
          projectId: ${project_id}
          parent: ${"projects/" + project_id + "/locations/" + location_id}
          body:
            substitutions:
                _VM_NAME: ${vm_name}
                _PROJECT_ID: ${project_id}
                _IMAGE_ZONE: ${image_zone}
                _BASE_IMAGE_FAMILY: ${base_image_family}
                _KITCHEN_SA_EMAIL: ${kitchen_sa_email}
                _NEW_IMAGE_NAME: ${new_image_name}
                _REPO_DIR: ${repo_dir}
                _PLAYBOOK_ARCHIVE_URI: ${playbook_archive_uri}
                _OS_FAMILY: ${os_family}
                _REGION: ${region}
            options:
              logging: ${logs_mode}
              dynamic_substitutions: true
              substitutionOption: ALLOW_LOOSE
            
            source:
              repoSource:
                projectId: ${repo_project_id}
                repoName: ${repo_name}
                dir: ${repo_dir}
                branchName: ${branch_name}
            timeout: 7200s
            tags:
                - ${os_family}
                - "ansible-build"
                - ${"wf-" + sys.get_env("GOOGLE_CLOUD_WORKFLOW_EXECUTION_ID")}
            steps:
              # 1) Package ansible playbooks and upload to GCS
              - name: gcr.io/google.com/cloudsdktool/cloud-sdk:latest
                id: package-playbooks
                entrypoint: /bin/bash
                env:
                    - _REPO_DIR=${_REPO_DIR}
                args:
                  - -ceu
                  - |
                    set -euxo pipefail

                    echo "Packing playbooks from repo dir: ${_REPO_DIR}"
                    echo "PWD is $(pwd)"
                    tar czf /tmp/ansible-playbooks.tgz ansible.cfg \
                    playbooks \
                    roles \
                    roles-template \
                    scripts \
                    vars
                    echo "Uploading playbooks to ${_PLAYBOOK_ARCHIVE_URI}"
                    gsutil cp /tmp/ansible-playbooks.tgz "${_PLAYBOOK_ARCHIVE_URI}"
                    
              # 2) Create bake VM with startup script
              - name: gcr.io/google.com/cloudsdktool/cloud-sdk:latest
                id: create-vm
                entrypoint: /bin/bash
                env:
                  - _OS_FAMILY=${os_family}
                  - _EXTRA_VARS=${extra_vars}
                args:
                  - -ceu
                  - |
                    set -euxo pipefail
                    echo "Creating bake VM: ${_VM_NAME}"
                    cd /workspace/${_REPO_DIR}
                    ls -R
                    gcloud beta compute instances create "${_VM_NAME}" \
                        --project="${_PROJECT_ID}" \
                        --zone="${_IMAGE_ZONE}" \
                        --machine-type="n1-standard-1" \
                        --image-family="${_BASE_IMAGE_FAMILY}" \
                        --image-project="${_PROJECT_ID}" \
                        --subnet=imgbake-bakery-usc1 \
                        --service-account="${_KITCHEN_SA_EMAIL}" \
                        --scopes="cloud-platform" \
                        --no-address \
                        --metadata=os-family="${_OS_FAMILY}",playbook-archive="${_PLAYBOOK_ARCHIVE_URI}",extra-vars="${_EXTRA_VARS}" \
                        --metadata-from-file startup-script="scripts/startup-ansible-bake.sh" | tee build.log
              # 3) Wait for VM to finish backing (startup script shuts it down)
              - name: gcr.io/google.com/cloudsdktool/cloud-sdk:latest
                id: wait-for-bake
                entrypoint: /bin/bash
                args:
                  - -ceu
                  - |
                    set -euxo pipefail
                    echo "Waiting for bake VM to stop: ${_VM_NAME}"

                    for i in {1..60}; do
                      _STATUS="$(gcloud beta compute instances describe "${_VM_NAME}" \
                                    --project="${_PROJECT_ID}" \
                                    --zone="${_IMAGE_ZONE}" \
                                    --format="value(status)")";
                      echo "VM Status: $${_STATUS}"
                      if [ "$${_STATUS}" = "TERMINATED" ]; then
                        echo "Bake VM terminated, continuing."
                        exit 0
                      fi
                      sleep 30
                    done
                    echo "Timeout waiting for bake VM to stop"; exit 2

              # 4) Create Image from RHEL bake VM disk
              - name: gcr.io/google.com/cloudsdktool/cloud-sdk:latest
                id: create-image
                entrypoint: /bin/bash
                env:
                    - _OS_FAMILY=${_OS_FAMILY}
                    - _REGION=${_REGION}
                args:
                  - -ceu
                  - |
                    set -euxo pipefail

                    echo "Creating image ${_NEW_IMAGE_NAME} from VM ${_VM_NAME}"

                    # Ensure VM is stopped
                    gcloud compute instances stop "${_VM_NAME}" \
                      --project="${_PROJECT_ID}" --zone="${_IMAGE_ZONE}" --quiet || true

                    echo "_OS_FAMILY=${_OS_FAMILY}"

                    gcloud compute images create "${_NEW_IMAGE_NAME}" \
                      --project="${_PROJECT_ID}" \
                      --source-disk="${_VM_NAME}" \
                      --source-disk-zone="${_IMAGE_ZONE}" \
                      --family="${_OS_FAMILY}" \
                      --storage-location="${_REGION}"

                    echo "artifact,0,id ${_PROJECT_ID}/${_NEW_IMAGE_NAME}" | tee build.log

              # 5) Cleanup VM
              - name: gcr.io/google.com/cloudsdktool/cloud-sdk:latest
                id: cleanup
                entrypoint: /bin/bash
                args:
                  - -ceu
                  - |
                    set -euxo pipefail

                    echo "Cleaning up VM ${_VM_NAME}"
                    gcloud compute instances delete "${_VM_NAME}" \
                          --project="${_PROJECT_ID}" \
                          --zone="${_IMAGE_ZONE}" \
                          --quiet || true
        result: buildResults
    - done:
        return:
          image_id: ${new_image_name}
          source_image_id: ${new_image_name}

promote_image:
  params: [image_id, source_image_id, project_id, location_id, skip_promotion]
  steps:
    - skip_image_promotion:
        switch:
          - condition: ${skip_promotion}
            next: return_skipped
    - the_build:
        call: googleapis.cloudbuild.v1.projects.builds.create
        args:
          projectId: ${project_id}
          parent: ${"projects/" + project_id + "/locations/" + location_id}
          body:
            source:
              repoSource:
                repoName: "gcp-ansible-playbooks"
                dir: "pipelines/schwab-rhel8"
                branchName: "master"
            steps:
              - name: "gcr.io/cloud-builders/gcloud"
                entrypoint: "bash"
                args:
                  - -c 
                  - |
                    # Promote the validated image to certified
                    CURRENT_IMAGE=$(gcloud compute images describe-from-family "schwab-rhel8"  --project=${_DISPLAY_CASE_PROJECT_ID} --format="value(name)")
                    echo $$CURRENT_IMAGE

                    gcloud compute images add-labels ${_CANDIDATE_IMAGE} \
                      --labels=schwab_status=certified,source_image=${_SOURCE_IMAGE_ID} > $$BUILDER_OUTPUT/output
                    
                    gcloud compute --project=${_DISPLAY_CASE_PROJECT_ID} \
                      images create '$${_CANDIDATE_IMAGE}-runtime' \
                      --description="custom machine image - schwab-rhel8 image" \
                      --family="schwab-rhel8" \
                      --source-image=${_CANDIDATE_IMAGE} \
                      --source-image-project=${_PROJECT_ID}
                      
                    gcloud compute --project=${_DISPLAY_CASE_PROJECT_ID} \
                      images add-labels ${_CANDIDATE_IMAGE} \
                      --labels=schwab_status=certified,image_family=schwab-rhel8,source_image=${_SOURCE_IMAGE_ID} > $$BUILDER_OUTPUT/output

                    gcloud compute images deprecate $$CURRENT_IMAGE --project=${_DISPLAY_CASE_PROJECT_ID} --state=DEPRECATED --obsolete-in 60d   
            substitutions:
                  _PROJECT_ID: ${project_id}
                  _CANDIDATE_IMAGE: ${image_id}
                  _DISPLAY_CASE_PROJECT_ID: "cs-sh-img-display-case1764"
                  _SOURCE_IMAGE_ID: ${source_image_id}
            options:
                  dynamic_substitutions: true
            tags: ["schwab-rhel8","promote_image","${sys.get_env(\"GOOGLE_CLOUD_WORKFLOW_EXECUTION_ID\")}"]
        result: the_promoteResults
    - return_the_results:
        return: ${"The image " +  image_id + ", built from " + source_image_id + ", has been promoted to display case and marked as certified" + text.decode(base64.decode(the_promoteResults.metadata.build.results.buildStepOutputs[0]))}
    - return_skipped:
        return: ${"The promotion of image " +  image_id + ", built from " + source_image_id + ", has been skipped."}

qualys_scan:
  params: [instance_name, override_scan_result, project_id, location_id]
  steps:
    - skip_instance_creation:
        switch:
          - condition: ${text.to_lower(override_scan_result) == "pass"}
            next: return_override_pass
          - condition: ${text.to_lower(override_scan_result) == "fail"}
            next: return_override_fail
    - get_the_instance_id:
        call: get_instance_id
        args:
          instance_name: ${instance_name}
          project_id: ${project_id}
          location_id: ${location_id}
        result: instance_id
    - define:
        assign:
          - i: 0
    - qualys_function:
        call: http.post
        args:
          url: https://us-central1-cs-sh-image-bakery1748.cloudfunctions.net/imgbake_qualys_scan_instance_report_function
          body:
            instance_id: ${instance_id}
          auth:
            type: OIDC
            audience: https://us-central1-cs-sh-image-bakery1748.cloudfunctions.net/imgbake_qualys_scan_instance_report_function
        result: qualys_results
    - logic:
        switch:
          - condition: ${text.to_lower(qualys_results.body) != "pending"}
            next: return_scan_results
        next: check_iteration
    - check_iteration:
        switch:
          - condition: ${i < 24}
            next: wait_step
        next: return_override_fail
    - wait_step:
        call: sys.sleep
        args:
          seconds: 3600
        next: iterate
    - iterate:
        assign:
          - i: ${i+1}
        next: qualys_function
    - return_scan_results:
        return: ${qualys_results.body}
    - return_override_pass:
        return: ${"Pass"}
    - return_override_fail:
        return: ${"Fail"}

validate_image:
  params: [image_id, project_id, location_id, instance_name, override_scan_result]
  steps:
    - skip_instance_creation:
        switch:
          - condition: ${instance_name == image_id + "-validation"}
            next: scan
    - create_instance:
